allow: Bash(powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command 'Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly | Where-Object { $_.InstanceId -like '\\''*VID_0403*'\\'' } | Select-Object Status,Problem,ProblemDescription,FriendlyName | Format-List; Write-Output '\\''--- present serial ports ---'\\''; Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly -Class Ports | Select-Object Status,FriendlyName | Format-List')

Bash(powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command 'Get-NetIPConfiguration | Where-Object { $_.IPv4Address -and $_.IPv4DefaultGateway } | ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ Adapter=$_.InterfaceAlias; IPv4=$_.IPv4Address.IPAddress; Prefix=$_.IPv4Address.PrefixLength; Gateway=$_.IPv4DefaultGateway.NextHop; DNS=\($_.DNSServer | Where-Object {$_.AddressFamily -eq 2} | Select-Object -Expand ServerAddresses\) -join '\\'','\\'' } } | Format-List')
